ursachen.warum: Freshly mixed dough sticks until the [[glutenbildung|gluten network]] has formed.
fix: Keep kneading, or stretch and fold

ursachen.titel: Too much water for the flour
ursachen.warum: White flour takes up less water than wholemeal or dark flour.
fix: Next time hold back some water and add it by feel

ursachen.warum: Rye doughs almost always stick; they form hardly any gluten.
fix: Work with wet hands or a dough scraper
